subject: On‑site planning: Priya Kapoor (Senior Serving Engineer) — interview scope & debrief ownership
messages:
From: Ana Silva <ana@talentmatch.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-11 09:02 -0700
Subject: Priya Kapoor — on‑site scheduling + materials

Hi Mark, Laura, Marissa —

Thanks for the time today. Priya (cc'd in follow-ups below) is available for an on‑site loop next Wednesday and Friday PST. She’s excited about the Senior Serving Engineer role and asked for a quick note on what each interviewer is expected to evaluate so she can prepare — particularly around production optimization and inference scale.

I’ve attached her resume (priya_kapoor_resume.pdf) and a short 1‑pager Acme shared about the product context. Proposed interviewer slate:
- System design (Markus) — 60m
- Serving/runtime deep dive (Karthik) — 45m
- Performance & reliability case (Laura) — 45m
- Bar‑raiser/leadership + debrief (Marissa) — 30m

Can you confirm the slate and whether you want any prep material added to the candidate packet? Also — who will own the debrief template and post‑loop hiring recommendation doc? I can coordinate logistics once the owners are set.

Attachments: priya_kapoor_resume.pdf

Thanks,
Ana Silva
Senior Recruiter, TalentMatch
On behalf of Acme AI
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-04-11 10:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Priya Kapoor — on‑site scheduling + materials

Thanks Ana — scheduling works. A few clarifications and asks from the hiring side:

1) Interview focus (short bullets we can include in candidate packet):
   - System design: vertical scaling for multi‑tenant inference, routing strategies, and cost tradeoffs (look for ability to reason about batching and sharding).
   - Serving/runtime deep dive: KV cache management, warmup strategies, and quantization impacts on latency distribution.
   - Perf & Reliability: SLO definition, incident triage example, and a small postmortem critique — prefer real examples.
   - Bar‑raiser slot: leadership + cross‑team collaboration, decision clarity, hiring bar assessment.

2) Debrief ownership: I can draft the initial recommendation doc and own the hire/no‑hire + rubric consolidation. However I’d like Marissa to own the bar‑raiser section and final sign‑off on level/compensation signal. Marissa — can you take the bar‑raiser & final level alignment?

3) Prepping the candidate: please add a short tech primer on our runtime (one page) and the interview focus bullets above. Ana, can you add that to the materials you send Priya?

I’ll block time for a 30m prep sync with interviewers the morning of the loop for quick expectations and signal calibration.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Inference Serving
Redwood Inference
